szoveg_eredeti:
On November 11, two songwriters will perform original music, live, at ElevenLabs Summit NYC, using voices ElevenLabs helped them restore and create.

Greg Kellner is a New York-based educator and community music leader who spent his life teaching through singing and playing guitar, until surgery for brain cancer in 2019 left him unable to sing. Abdi Omar has cerebral palsy and has never had a spoken voice, so he designed his own from scratch with ElevenLabs. Now, both write and record music with ElevenMusic .

 Gabi Leibowitz , who leads our Impact Program, will share the stories behind 1 Million Voices, then sit down with Greg and Abdi to talk about losing a voice, building a new one, and making music again.
